title: Vapouriz 50/50 Fizzy Cola Bottles 10ml

Vapouriz E-Liquids are expertly-crafted by Vapouriz Labs UK to deliver intense flavour and stunning vapour production for your e-cigarette setup. What Is 50/50 E Liquid? 50/50 e-liquid is called so because it contains a 50% Vegetable Glycerine, 50% Propylene Glycol ratio, which allows for an extremely versatile vaping experience. These liquids can be used in Starter Vape Kits, High powered Sub Ohm Kits and Pod Vape Kits. For more information, Check out the full 50/50 vape juice guide
